messages:
maya: FYI blocking PR #4123 (migration guide + SDK snippet). Docs-preview failed on vale, linkcheck, and spell. Need quick fixes before 15:00 merge window today. Any volunteers? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
tj: can you paste the preview link? I'll take a look after stand.
maya: https://docs-preview.internal/redwood/pr/4123 — main failures at bottom. ci-bot summary pasted below.
ci-bot: docs-preview failed — vale (2 rules), linkcheck (3 broken URLs), spellcheck (one tech term flagged). Logs: /artifacts/4123/preview.log
oliver: I can handle the linkcheck and one vale tweak. Not sure about the SDK snippet change — need rachel to confirm API surface.
rachel: I'm in PTO until noon but can review snippet by 12:30. Which lines changed?
maya: snippet shows new param name `client_opts` -> `client_config`. It's in `examples/sdk/usage.md`.
oliver: easy rename, I can update snippet and run vale locally. What's the vale rule failing?
maya: vale: PreferActiveVoice and LineLength in that paragraph. Just reword a sentence and wrap the long line.
tj: I'll run linkcheck locally, but quick patch idea: replace the three broken URLs with archived links and add redirects note.
oliver: putting together PR now with fixes + changelog note. Will ping for quick reviews. ETA 30m.
maya: thanks — if we can't get all green by 15:00, do we want to gate merge until tomorrow? cc @eng-merge-bot
docs-bot: FYI: merge window policy — docs must pass preview to merge. Exceptions need +1 from docs lead and eng lead.
rachel: if oliver's changes are just snippet rename and link swap, +1 from me once CI passes. Enjoy your lunch :sandwich:
maya: awesome, thanks. tagging reviewers in the PR: @rachel @tj @oliver
oliver: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4150 — running `make docs-preview` locally now.
ci-bot: started docs-preview job for PR 4150
tj: I'll queue a quick run in CI once oliver pushes.
maya: closing loop — will try to merge by 15:00 if all green, otherwise hold until tomorrow morning. Thanks team :heart:
